name: AI Ceiling Fan Trend: Change Your Outfit on Every Blade Pass
blurb: The AI ceiling fan trend is the TikTok clip filmed straight down through a slowly turning ceiling fan: you lie on the floor, a blade sweeps across the lens, and each time it passes you wear a new outfit.
